kpg-extinction.summary: An asteroid impact at Chicxulub ended the non-avian dinosaurs and about three quarters of all species, opening the way for mammals.

himalayan-orogeny.summary: The Indian plate, having drifted north from Gondwana, collided with Eurasia and drove up the Himalaya and the Tibetan Plateau. The range is still rising by roughly 5 mm a year.
himalayan-orogeny.note: Estimates for the onset of continental collision range from about 59 Ma to 50 Ma depending on whether initial contact or full suturing is dated.

sources.title: USGS — The Himalayas: Two continents collide
